description: Ends one of your coin keys now, as the coin page's Developers dialog does: { ok }. It is refused from then on and its webhook stops; it can't be made live again. id is the key's id, as create_coin_key answered it (GET /api/v2/me/coinkeys lists your keys with their ids). Works whatever the coin API's switch, so a leaked key can always be ended. 404 for an id that is not one of your live keys. Takes the token from sign_in, as token or as the request's Authorization: Bearer header.

token.description: The token sign_in gave. Not needed when the request sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

name: revoke_coin_key
title: Revoke a coin key
